threat_event: Ransomware enters through the dispatch vendor's always-on remote access and encrypts the CAD servers, dispatch consoles, and PTC administration workstation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on vendor VPN appliance with one shared account; office LAN routes freely to the dispatch VLAN; no EDR or monitoring
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-02 (PTC workstation); SYS-07; BP-01; BP-02
existing_controls: HQ firewall; signature antivirus; daily backups
treatment_plan: Vendor access only on request through a jump host with named accounts, MFA, and session logging; filter the dispatch VLAN; MSP-managed EDR with 24x7 triage

threat_event: Phishing email compromises an office workstation and the attacker moves laterally into the dispatch VLAN
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No phishing training or exercises; no filtering between office LAN and dispatch VLAN; no EDR
existing_controls: Email filtering in the productivity suite; MFA on email
treatment_plan: Awareness module for all staff and quarterly phishing exercises; dispatch VLAN filtering (same work as R-001)

threat_event: Dispatch server backups are deleted or encrypted along with production, so the CAD system cannot be restored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup vault in the same cloud account as production; not immutable; no offline copy; never restore-tested
existing_controls: Daily backup jobs
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention; weekly offline copy at North Yard; quarterly restore test with malware scan

threat_event: Attacker logs in to the staff remote-access VPN or a server administrator account with a stolen or guessed password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on the staff VPN or server administrator accounts; 4 stale contractor administrator accounts
existing_controls: Password length policy; lockout after 10 failures
treatment_plan: MFA on both VPNs and all administrator accounts; remove stale administrators; quarterly access review

threat_event: During an unpracticed switch to manual dispatch after a CAD outage, a dispatcher issues a conflicting track warrant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Paper track warrant procedure from 2019, never exercised; 3 of 6 dispatchers hired since 2023 have never used it
affected_asset_or_process: BP-01 train dispatching; company main track
regulatory_driver: C-TRANSPORTATION-BM (RC.RP-01); C-TRANSPORTATION-S05 (225.9 if an accident results)
existing_controls: Operating rules require track warrant repeat-back; train sheets printed each shift
treatment_plan: Update the manual dispatch procedure; twice-yearly manual dispatch drills; paper forms and a printed track chart at each console

threat_event: A cyber attack is not reported to TSA within 24 hours, leading to enforcement and loss of TSA and CISA help
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nobody in IT knew cyber attacks are reportable under 1570.203; no trigger list; 2025 mailbox compromise not reported
existing_controls: Physical-event reporting to TSOC works
treatment_plan: Cyber triggers and TSOC call in POL-03 and the P08 runbook; brief dispatchers and IT; tabletop

threat_event: TSA requests the location of PIH cars during an IT outage and the answer takes longer than 30 minutes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Location procedure needs a working workstation and the TMS; no offline list
existing_controls: Tested drill answered in 18 minutes (2026-03-11)
treatment_plan: Clean standby laptop with TMS access at dispatch; RSSM car list printed every 4 hours
owner: Car Management and Customer Service Manager

threat_event: Attacker exploits a known vulnerability in the unpatched dispatch server operating system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dispatch servers 2 years behind on patches because the vendor certifies slowly; no vulnerability scanning
existing_controls: Servers not reachable from the internet
treatment_plan: Quarterly vendor-certified patch cycle; authenticated scans; compensating controls from segmentation

threat_event: Attacker exploits outdated radio gateway firmware to disrupt dispatcher radio consoles
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Radio gateway firmware never updated; management interface on the dispatch VLAN
existing_controls: Fallback repeater and handheld radios at dispatch
treatment_plan: Firmware plan with the radio vendor; restrict management interface to the jump host

threat_event: Attacker uses default credentials on a wayside detector modem to change settings or suppress alarm messages
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manufacturer default credentials on all 3 detector modems (found in P07 testing); modems reachable over cellular
existing_controls: Detector logic runs locally and announces by radio even if the modem is changed
treatment_plan: Change credentials now; private cellular APN; add modems to the inventory

threat_event: Actions on a shared dispatch console login cannot be tied to a dispatcher, hiding misuse or error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two dispatch consoles use one shared Windows login
existing_controls: CAD application requires a named login
treatment_plan: Named Windows accounts with fast user switching on all consoles

threat_event: A former employee uses a still-active crew tablet or TMS account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Accounts disabled 3 to 6 days after the last day; no periodic review
existing_controls: HR emails IT at termination; tablets returned to the yard office
treatment_plan: Same-day disable triggered by the HR ticket; monthly reconciliation

threat_event: The PTC back office service is unavailable, so interchange trains cannot run on the Class I segment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single hosted service; no agreed restoration priorities or fallback in the contract
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2 (P09); 99.5% monthly availability commitment
treatment_plan: Obtain vendor restoration plan; agree fallback with the host railroad; add to contingency plan

threat_event: An attacker with access to the PTC administration workstation changes locomotive or crew data in the back office
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Workstation on the flat dispatch VLAN; administrator login without a hardware key; general web browsing allowed
existing_controls: MFA on the back office portal
treatment_plan: Dedicated hardened workstation, no email or browsing; phishing-resistant MFA; place on the restricted zone

threat_event: Wrong train consist data from the TMS causes PTC initialization failures or wrong train data for enforcement
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consists keyed by clerks; no validation against the car list at initialization; failures not logged
existing_controls: Conductor verifies the train list against cars at departure
treatment_plan: TMS validation rules; log initialization failures with cause; monthly review
owner: Car Management and Customer Service Manager

threat_event: The TMS SaaS provider has a multi-day outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03; BP-04 car management and billing
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2; availability commitment; daily consist export to the file server
treatment_plan: Accepted by the President and General Manager: billing can wait; train lists come from the daily export

threat_event: SSI or the hazmat security plan is disclosed to people without a need to know
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SSI stored in a file area readable by all 37 office users
existing_controls: TSA documents arrive marked
treatment_plan: Restricted SSI library with named access; mark derived documents

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects shipper or vendor payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Finance staff not trained on payment fraud; bank detail changes approved by email (as in the 2025 incident)
existing_controls: MFA on email
treatment_plan: Call-back verification for bank detail changes; finance-specific training

threat_event: A hurricane damages the HQ dispatch center, taking out both CAD servers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Primary and standby CAD servers in the same room; no alternate dispatch site
existing_controls: Generator at HQ; operations stop for named storms under the hurricane plan
treatment_plan: Move the standby server and an alternate dispatch desk to the North Yard office

threat_event: Intruder enters a radio tower shelter with a copied common key and damages equipment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One padlock key for all 7 tower shelters and 3 detector bungalows, held by 22 people
existing_controls: Door alarms at tower sites report to dispatch
treatment_plan: Rekey with site-specific keys; key log

threat_event: An intruder stays undetected for weeks and prepares a disruptive attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No central logging or EDR; server logs overwrite after about 14 days; no log review
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Central log workspace with 1-year retention; EDR alerting; weekly review

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's remote management tool reaches every office endpoint
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP tool has unrestricted access; no security terms or review of the MSP
existing_controls: Contract with the MSP
treatment_plan: Security addendum at renewal; MFA and IP restrictions on MSP tooling; annual MSP review

threat_event: The dispatch vendor ends support for the installed CAD version
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Version two releases behind; upgrade not budgeted
existing_controls: Current support contract to 2027-12
treatment_plan: Budget the upgrade in 2027 with the segmentation project

threat_event: Employee personal information (including engineer and conductor medical certification records) is stolen during a ransomware attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HR exports kept on the file server replacement in the cloud tenant; no data loss prevention
existing_controls: Encryption at rest by the cloud provider
treatment_plan: Remove HR exports from the file server; restrict HR folder; log access

threat_event: Staff do not recognize or report a cyber event, so response and TSA reporting start late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security training for crews, shop, and dispatch; no reporting channel for cyber events
existing_controls: Dispatch center is staffed 24/7 and receives physical security reports
treatment_plan: Awareness module for all employees; publish the report-to-dispatch rule for cyber events

threat_event: The AI defect detection model misses a defect and inspectors start relying on it instead of the required visual inspection
threat_source: AI model error and automation bias
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot has no documented human review rule; model not validated on South Subdivision conditions
regulatory_driver: C-TRANSPORTATION-S08 (213.233(b): devices may only supplement visual inspection)
existing_controls: Qualified inspectors still perform all required inspections
treatment_plan: Written human-in-the-loop rule; validation and monitoring plan (P10)

threat_event: The AI vendor keeps or reuses track and bridge imagery that reveals infrastructure details
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contract silent on data use and retention
existing_controls: Images stored in the company tenant
treatment_plan: Data use and deletion terms in the contract (P10)

threat_event: Denial of service against the public website and shipper portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-hosted; outside company control
existing_controls: Vendor DDoS protection
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low

threat_event: Security and incident records are lost, so the company cannot show TSA or FRA what happened
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention rule for security records; logs short-lived
existing_controls: Safety department keeps FRA records
treatment_plan: Retention schedule for security and incident records (POL-01)

threat_event: Detector alarm messages over cellular are intercepted or spoofed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Alarm messages sent over public cellular without encryption
existing_controls: Detectors also announce by radio to the train crew
treatment_plan: Private cellular APN or VPN for detector and crossing monitor modems

threat_event: A lost or stolen crew tablet exposes train lists and bulletins
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tablets carried in personal vehicles
existing_controls: Device management with encryption, PIN, and remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low

threat_event: Someone tampers with an onboard PTC unit on an unattended locomotive
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Locomotives tie up unattended at outlying sidings
existing_controls: Locked and sealed housings; initialization test detects faults before departure
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low
